title: Item — stock and service master
description: The item master every transaction line links to. The harvested distinction that matters is is_stock_item: an item either moves through a warehouse (and so commits stock on a delivery note or a purchase receipt) or it does not (a service, a charge), and the transactional spine decides whether to write a stock ledger entry from that flag. uom is required because a quantity without its unit is not a quantity.

id.description: The item code every transaction line cites.

uom.description: Unit of measure (Nos, Kg, Hour). Required: a quantity with no unit cannot be committed to a ledger.

is_stock_item.description: Whether the item moves through a warehouse. This is the flag the transactional spine reads to decide whether a document commits stock.

standard_rate.description: The default selling rate a transaction line inherits when the caller sends none.

valuation_rate.description: The current stock valuation rate, which is what a stock ledger entry debits.

has_batch_no.description: Whether a stock movement of this item must name a batch.

shelf_life_days.description: Shelf life in days; absent for items that do not expire.

harvest: the item master field surface (uom, item group, standard and valuation rate)
the is_stock_item flag that gates whether a document commits stock
batch tracking as an item attribute rather than a transaction attribute
x-erp-provenance.note: Field shapes from the upstream item doctype, re-expressed. No upstream file was read into this repository; no upstream code, schema or text is copied.
